artwork.title: The Starry Night
artwork.subtitle: De sterrennacht
artwork.description: Painted during Van Gogh's stay at the Saint-Paul-de-Mausole clinic in Saint-Rémy, this work shows a dreamlike view from his window before sunrise.

artist.biography: Vincent van Gogh was a Dutch Post-Impressionist painter whose expressive use of color and brushwork had a lasting influence on modern art.

exhibition.title: Van Gogh
exhibition.subtitle: Light and Color
exhibition.description: This exhibition presents a selection of works highlighting the development of Vincent van Gogh's artistic language.
